note: Huron NF campground established in 1909, on the River Road National Scenic Byway above the AuSable River and beside the Lumberman's Monument Visitor Center; secluded, shaded sites in a red pine plantation, fully accessible. The Highbanks Trail starts at the campground. 15 mi W of Oscoda. --Claude
